The '''Syliure-25 hyperdrive module''' was a [[Hyperspace transport ring/Legends|hyperdrive docking ring]] produced by [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and sold for 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was designed to offer [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] that were too small to allow for an onboard [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. The engines were fitted with Class 2.0 hyperdrives, connected to a [[R1-series astromech droid/Legends|R1]] or [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]].<ref name="Edge of the Empire" />
